features.name: Q_A_at_H
features.computation: count of hub-waiting occupants whose HIDDEN target_exit == 'A'
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3
features.note: Reads the hidden per-occupant intent label target_exit. Non-compliant occupants keep their parity baseline label, so after a non-parity global action the minority-label count at the hub is a read-out of hidden non-compliance (quantified in feature_leakage_audit.json). It is also the only feature that changes when a candidate relabels (action-independence audit).

features.name: residual_cap_H_CE1_normalized
features.computation: 1.0 if sim.t < t_h else 2/6
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3. The hazard update is step 1 of tick t, executed BEFORE the decision (step 2/3), so the degraded value at t == t_h is already physically true at decision time
features.note: Binary 'hazard has occurred' indicator. Never reveals t_h before onset (verified on all replayed states).

features.name: normalized_time
features.computation: t / MAX_STEPS
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3
features.note: Time since alarm; known to an operator.

features.name: normalized_remaining
features.computation: (N - evacuated) / N
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3
features.note: Needs the initial headcount N and exit counters.

features.name: normalized_sim_time_temporal
features.computation: t / MAX_STEPS (== normalized_time)
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3
features.note: Exact duplicate of normalized_time; excluded as redundant.

features.name: normalized_decision_index
features.computation: (t/5)/(180/5) (== normalized_time at decision ticks)
features.available_when: compute_observation(sim) after tick t-1 completes (sim.t already incremented to the decision tick t), BEFORE the candidate's relabeling in tick t's step 2/3
features.note: Exact duplicate of normalized_time; excluded as redundant.

features.name: time_since_hazard_onset_normalized
features.computation: (t - t_h)/MAX_STEPS whenever t_h <= MAX_STEPS, else sentinel -2.0; computed even when t < t_h
features.available_when: every observation, including before the hazard exists
features.note: Before onset, t - value*MAX_STEPS recovers the exact future onset tick; the sentinel reveals whether a hazard will ever happen. Source: observation.py `has_hazard = sim.t_h <= MAX_STEPS`. Confirmed empirically on the replayed states.

features.name: hazard_phase
features.computation: 0.0 no-hazard scenario / 0.5 if t < t_h / 1.0 if t >= t_h
features.available_when: every observation
features.note: 0.5 before onset reveals that a hazard WILL happen (vs 0.0 in S1). Only the post-onset 1.0 is observable, and it duplicates residual_cap_H_CE1_normalized.
